gpt-5-mini.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2017 gross claims outstanding were $39.9m. During 2017 the syndicate recorded prioryear favourable development, notably the 2015 underwriting year which closed with a declared profit of $19.3m and the 2016 year which benefited from lower than average notifications. This prioryear development therefore represents a release. The 2017 underwriting year, by contrast, was lossmaking driven by multiple 2017 natural catastrophe events (Hurricane Harvey, Irma, Maria, Mexican earthquakes and Californian wildfires) which materially increased current year claims.

The 2016 underwriting year has also benefited from a lower than average level of claims notifications and currently forecasts a return on capacity of 30%.
The 2017 underwriting year is currently loss making due to the natural catastrophe events.

Syndicate 6107 experienced a number of natural catastrophes in 2017 including hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria, the Mexican earthquakes and the Californian wildfires, which were significant contributors to the syndicate experiencing a claims ratio of 91% (2016: 29%).
